scope: LO quark-parton-model F_2 for photon exchange (PDG Eq. 18.18) and the O(alpha_s) longitudinal structure function F_L from the LO coefficient functions of Moch, Vermaseren and Vogt (Eqs. 1-3), rewritten in the Altarelli-Martinelli form by a SymPy change of variables (perturbative argument at O(alpha_s), mu_R = mu_F = Q). SYNTHETIC ONLY: no published F_L value was read, so the numerical work is demonstrated on synthetic toy densities with an analytic closed-form check, not on a published benchmark.
exclusions: Any published or measured F_L or F_2 value; no comparison with data
NLO and NNLO coefficient functions, DGLAP evolution, parton-distribution sets
Heavy-quark mass effects, target-mass and higher-twist corrections, small-x resummation
Z and W exchange, gamma-Z interference, xF_3, polarized structure functions
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field

capabilities.name: fl-alpha-s-derivation
capabilities.scope: SymPy: change of variables in the convolution, flavour algebra (non-singlet plus singlet), and the O(alpha_s) coefficient functions rewritten identically as the Altarelli-Martinelli integrand; positivity and alpha_s -> 0 limit (perturbative argument at O(alpha_s), not formal proof)

capabilities.name: fl-f2-toy-prediction
capabilities.scope: F_2 and F_L on a 6 x 2 grid of (x, Q^2) for SYNTHETIC Beta-form densities and toy alpha_s values; adaptive quadrature against the exact SymPy closed form (relative tolerance 1e-10) with a Gauss-Legendre convergence study. Analytic check only: no published F_L benchmark was read
